audit.why: Even skill matchup through levels 1-3, Morgana takes over 4-6 once Black Shield eats Beat Drop, teamfights swing back to Seraphine late — this is already reflected accurately in the level chart and breakdown.difficulty.

Level 6 Soul Shackles + landed Dark Binding, first-item haste sustaining Black Shield uptime, and Seraphine's late AoE/Encore scaling are the real spikes and are already stated in spikes[] and phases[].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names the cooldown-defining ability but has no real number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED), so neither bullet actually explains its own headline.
audit.why: Beat Drop (E) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and Black Shield (E) is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — real numbers make the cooldown-window advice concrete instead of vague. The Do/Don't bullets need to independently justify their own titles (banking Q's cooldown; not wasting Black Shield on chip poke) rather than restating the trade lines.

edits.before: - Seraphine Beat Drop (Root): matchup-defining — Roots the already-slowed — dodge it and the song never builds. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Seraphine's Beat Drop (E) root is down 11s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — dodge the line and her combo dies with it. Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed — save it for the root, not chip poke. The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Dark Binding is 10s cooldown, 1250 range — bank it and commit when your carry can follow.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield breaks the instant Beat Drop lands on it — save the barrier for her root, not her High Note poke.
